wizard.passwordHint: TimeBuddy asks for this at launch, so it does not open straight into your hours.
wizard.recoveryHint: Write this down somewhere safe. It is the only way back in if you forget your password — your hours are never lost, but without it the password cannot be changed.
wizard.backupHint: A folder that syncs — OneDrive, for instance — means a broken laptop is not a lost year.
wizard.workHint: One client and one project, so the Timer has something to start on. More can be added later.
